paite: Ka Pathian aw, hon doute a pan hon humbit inla; hon sualte a pan hon humbit in.
heading: Saul In Mi Sawl A David That Dia A-inn A Atan Lai Ua. David La / Bitna Dia Thumna

paite: Thil hihkhialte a pan hon humbit inla, sisan suah hatte a pan hon hondam in.
TOUPA aw, ka tatlekna ziak hilou in, ka khelh ziak leng hilou in, ngai in, ka hinna atang gige hi, mihatte hon sual ding in akikhawm uhi.
Ka khelh louhpi in leng hon sual ding in akisa ua; hon panpih ding in kihihhalh inla, en in.
TOUPA aw, sepaihte' Pathian, Israel' Pathian, nangmah ngei nam chih gawt ding in thou inla; milepchiah giloutakte peuhmah hawi ke'n. Selah
Nitaklam in ahong nawn ua, ui bang in aham vengvung ua, khopi kimvel ah apai uhi.
Ngai in akam un asa-ikkhia ua; amuk uah namsaute a-om a, kua athei a-om a! achi maimah uhi.
Himahleh, TOUPA aw, nang amau na nuihsan zaw ding a; nam chih na nuihsan ding hi.
Ahatna ziak in amah ka ngak nilouh ding a, Pathian ka insang ahi ngal a.
Ka tung a zahngai Pathian in ahon dawn ding a, Pathian in ka melmate tung ah ka thudeih ahon musak ding hi.
Amau that ke'nla, huchi lou in zaw ka mite'n amangngilh kha ding ua; TOUPA aw, ka phaw pen uh, Na thilhihtheihna in hihdalh inla, hihniam in.
Akam khelhna ziak un leh amuk ua thupawt ziak in akisaktheihna ngei uah awk uhen; athugen zel uh hamse lohna leh zuauthu ziak in leng.
Amaute thangpai in hihmangthang inla, a-om nawnlouhna ding un hihmangthang inla, Pathian in Jakobte lak ah vai ahawm chih thei chiat uhen; kawlmong pha in.
Huan nitaklam in hong uhenla, ui bang in ham vengvung uhenla, khopi kimvel ah pai uhen.
Amau nek ding zong in avakvak ding ua, atai kei uleh a-om zanhak ding uhi.
Himahleh ke'n na hatna thu la in ka sa ding a; ahi, zingsang in na zahngaihna thu nuamtak in la in ka sa ding hi; nang ka insang, ka mangbat ni a ka kihumbitna na hi ngal a.
Ka hatna aw, nang phat in la ka sa ding a; Pathian ka insang, ka tung a siam Pathian ahi ngal a.
